excerpt.zh: 我们探测到了来自这颗星球的间歇性能量峰值。这些读数表明了一些强大的、远超我们所观察到的未开智物种所具有能力的某种东西。
excerpt.en: We have detected intermittent energy spikes coming from the planet. These readings indicate something powerful, and far beyond the capabilities of the pre-sapient inhabitants we've observed.

scope.zh: 异常定义（生成条件、等级、次数限制）与全部结果事件已对照源文件核对。
scope.en: Anomaly definition (spawn conditions, level, once-limits) and every outcome event checked against the source.

texts.zh: 我们探测到了来自这颗星球的间歇性能量峰值。这些读数表明了一些强大的、远超我们所观察到的未开智物种所具有能力的某种东西。
texts.en: We have detected intermittent energy spikes coming from the planet. These readings indicate something powerful, and far beyond the capabilities of the pre-sapient inhabitants we've observed.

sections.zh: 我们探测到了来自这颗星球的间歇性能量峰值。这些读数表明了一些强大的、远超我们所观察到的未开智物种所具有能力的某种东西。
sections.en: We have detected intermittent energy spikes coming from the planet. These readings indicate something powerful, and far beyond the capabilities of the pre-sapient inhabitants we've observed.

texts.zh:
我们标记出了[From.GetName]上能量波动的源头，它源自一座位于未开智生物领地中心的金字塔形建筑。我们发现当地人口怪异地聚集在建筑周围。

我们若想要确认该物体的功能，则无可避免地会与这颗行星的居民打交道。
texts.en:
We have pinpointed the source of the energy fluctuations on [From.GetName] to a monolithic structure in the heart of the pre-sapient territory. The local population have been observed curiously congregating around the structure.

If we are to ascertain the purpose of this object, interaction with the planet's inhabitants is inevitable.

label.en: Send down a team to begin investigations.

label.zh: 我们还有更重要的事要处理。
label.en: We have more important matters to focus on.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们的团队开始着手调查[From.From.GetName]上的建筑。它是一座古老的四棱锥结构。科学家汇报在它的周围区域会听到怪异的低语，因此恰如其分地称之为“低语方尖碑”。

这座金字塔似乎在这个星球上的未开智物种所呈现的基本信仰系统中起着不可替代的作用。一个在这种智慧等级的物种甚至还没有开始使用工具时，却在发展复杂的精神实践，这是非比寻常的。

[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]领地意识很强，而且很容易被激怒。我们的到来打扰到了他们，越来越多的生物聚集到了金字塔附近。我们可能需要一些强制措施才能靠近这座建筑了。
texts.en:
Our team has begun investigating the structure on [From.From.GetName]. It is an ancient four-sided pyramid. Scientists report hearing strange whispers in its vicinity and have aptly named it the 'Murmuring Monolith'.

The Monolith appears to play an integral part in a rudimentary belief system observed by the planet's pre-sapient species. It is unusual to witness a species at this level of sentience developing complex spiritual practices when they have yet to begin using tools.

The [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] are territorial and easily provoked. Our arrival has disturbed them, and more have begun gathering around the Monolith. Gaining access to the structure will require force.

label.zh: 我们必须博得他们的信任。

tooltips.zh: 我们会教会这些未开智物种崇拜我们。
tooltips.en: We will teach this pre-sapient species to worship us.

tooltips.zh: 我们会教会这些未开智物种崇拜我们。
tooltips.en: We will teach this pre-sapient species to worship us.

label.zh: 他们不构成威胁。不理会就行。
label.en: They pose no threat. Leave them alone.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, that planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个前智慧物种的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for this pre-sapient species appears here.

texts.zh: 让[beholder_planet.GetName]上的[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]逐渐适应我们的存在让我们有可能靠近低语金字塔。如果他们降低对我们的警惕我们就能在他们当中自由活动，甚至会有机会进一步研究他们的物种。
texts.en: Acclimatizing the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] on [beholder_planet.GetName] to our presence will help us gain access to the Murmuring Monolith. If they lower their guard around us we can move freely among them, and may also have opportunities to learn more about their species.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个前智慧物种的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for this pre-sapient species appears here.

texts.zh:
在与[beholder_planet.GetName]上的[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]共处了一段时间后，他们不再那么害怕我们了。我们对其社会结构建立了基本的理解。

新的一群[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]开始涌向金字塔。与最初的保卫领土的行为相比，它们现在似乎很平静，甚至有所期待。有什么事情要发生了。
texts.en:
After spending some time with the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] on [beholder_planet.GetName], they appear less frightened by us. We are building a basic understanding of their social structures.

A fresh influx of [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] have begun crowding the Monolith. In contrast with their initial territorial behavior, they now seem to be calm, and even anticipatory. Something is about to happen.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个前智慧物种的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for this pre-sapient species appears here.

texts.zh: 当所有的[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]都聚集到了低语金字塔周围时，我们观测到了一个前所未见的现象。一种冷静的感觉一瞬间在兽群中涤荡开。这些生物仿佛被什么看不见的力量定住了。我们的一些科学家也被这一不寻常的现象影响，短时间失去了与现实的关联。当他们回过神来时称，他们与那座低语金字塔发生了直接的对话。
texts.en: As all the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] gathered around the Murmuring Monolith, we observed a phenomenon unlike anything we have previously encountered. A sense of calm washed over the crowd. The creatures were transfixed by an invisible force. Some of our scientists were caught up in this paranormal event, and for a moment, lost touch with reality. When they came to, they claimed to have communed directly with the Murmuring Monolith.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个前智慧物种的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for this pre-sapient species appears here.

texts.zh:
来自我们科学家的关于最近与低语金字塔发生沟通的汇报相当地耐人寻味。据说，这样的通灵经历能让人感受到解放和转变。

科学家将这一事件称为“低语呢喃”，并坚称是那座金字塔直接与他们沟通的。在短暂的接触期间，参与者可以共享他们内心最深处的想法，并被信任和理解的感受所包裹着。

当这一效应结束时，金字塔的能量输出骤降。也许我们应该找到一种重新与金字塔建立联系的方法。
texts.en:
The report from our scientists regarding the recent communion with the Murmuring Monolith makes for an interesting read. Supposedly, the ordeal was a liberating and transformative experience.

The scientists now refer to the event as 'The Murmuring', and maintain that the Monolith made direct contact with them. In the brief moment of contact, the participants were able to share their innermost thoughts with all involved, and were overcome by a sense of trust and understanding.

When the effects faded, the Monolith's energy emissions plummeted. Perhaps we could devise a way to reestablish contact with the Monolith.

texts.zh: 通过将能量集中在低语金字塔的内部部件上，我们或许可以重现低语呢喃现象，并实现进一步的接触。
texts.en: By concentrating bursts of energy on the internal components of the Murmuring Monolith, we may be able to recreate the Murmuring phenomenon, and achieve further contact.

texts.zh:
我们成功地复现了第一次低语呢喃时的条件，开启了与金字塔的第二次交流。这次，我们成功地维持了这一现象，并且与一个远在他处利用方尖碑作为媒介的实体进行了接触。

该实体称自己为凝望者，声称自己身处虚境之内，是在另一个次元利用金字塔进行交流。它以能量为食，同意为我们提供一些帮助来交换供养。
texts.en:
We successfully recreated the conditions of the first Murmuring, and initiated a second communion with the Monolith. This time we have been able to sustain the phenomenon and have established contact with an entity who is using the Monolith as a conduit to reach out from another location.

The entity has identified itself as The Beholder. It claims to exist within the Shroud, and uses the Monolith to reach out from a different plane of existence. It feeds on energy, and has agreed to offer us assistance in exchange for a feast.

label.en: Feed it the energy it needs.

label.zh: 我们之后会给你能量的，放心吧。
label.en: It will have energy, over time.

label.zh: 我们之后会给你能量的，放心吧。
label.en: It will have energy, over time.

label.zh: 我们之后会给你能量的，放心吧。
label.en: It will have energy, over time.
We have no reason to trust it.

texts.zh:
我们按要求提供了能量，完成了和凝望者的交易。能量刚一交付，金字塔就开始发出高频振动。随后它开始摇晃，周围地面开始坍塌。随着巨石上升，它的整体逐渐显露，我们才发现它的本体至少比我们最离谱的估计还要再大上两倍之多。

这座金字塔是一座巨大的八面体结构，它悬浮到了空中，掩盖其上的尘土徐徐落下。随着它飞向[beholder_planet.GetName]大气层的深处，行星的当地居民痛苦地尖叫了起来。

现在我们知道了，低语金字塔是一座拥有太空航行能力的硕大无朋的舰船。它现在正环绕着[beholder_planet.GetName]。
texts.en:
We fulfilled our end of the bargain with the Beholder, delivering the energy as requested. Upon receipt of the power, the Monolith began emitting high-frequency vibrations. It then began shaking, and the ground surrounding it crumbled, as the Monolith rose, revealing itself to be at least two times larger than even our most outlandish estimates.

A huge octahedral structure, the Monolith was suspended in the air as dirt and dust fell to the ground. The inhabitants of the planet screeched in panic as it took to the skies, climbing high into the atmosphere of [beholder_planet.GetName].

It is now clear that the Murmuring Monolith is a colossal vessel, capable of spaceflight. It currently orbits [beholder_planet.GetName].

tooltips.zh: 凝望者作为一名领袖加入你的帝国
tooltips.en: The Beholder joins your Empire as a Leader

label.zh: 你需求能量的目的是什么？
label.en: To what end do you seek energy?

responses.zh:
在长时间的沉默之后，传输频道中渐渐开始被静电噪声填满，它一直变强，听到的人无不被无数的情绪所征服，包括衰弱的遗憾和强烈的欲望等等。有太多的念头无法逐一过滤，但有一个声音可以穿透这一切噪音:

是观察。
responses.en:
After a long silence, static begins to fill the transmission, steadily increasing until those listening are overcome with a myriad of emotions, from debilitating regrets to compelling desires. Too much to filter through, but for one thing that pierces through the noise:

To observe.

label.zh: 你可以为我们的文明做什么？
label.en: What can you do for our civilization?

responses.zh:
一连串不连贯的低语反复回荡。

秘密……展露无疑。通过……道路……解开了。的潜力……虚境……开始。我们表示欢迎……让我们……用你的……引导……向那里。

尽管这段断断续续的信息可以有多种解释，但毫无疑问，肯定和灵能还有虚境是有关系的。
responses.en:
A string of incoherent, whispering voices echoes forth.

Secrets... laid bare. By the potential of... the path... unlocked. The Shroud ... begins. We offer welcome... Let us... use your... guide... there.

Although the patchy message is open to interpretation, there is little doubt that psionic energy and the Shroud are involved.

responses.zh:
一个声音以惊人的清晰度渐强起来：

刹那，与永恒。无相，与万物……你们的语言不够有效。我们类似于“目的”。目前，任何进一步的定义都超出了你的理解范围。虚境无边无垠，你们要学的还有很多。
responses.en:
With surprising clarity, a single voice swells:

Fleeting, and eternal. Nothing, and everything... Your language is ineffective. We are akin to 'purpose.' For now, any further definition lies beyond your grasp. The Shroud is vast and there is much to learn.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh: 我们已经驯化[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]将我们视为神明。他们现在温顺可欺并向我们寻求庇佑。我们非凡的科技在它们眼中无异于魔法，操纵他们的信仰体系简直信手拈来。我们现在可以自如地前往低语金字塔了。
texts.en: We have trained the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] to look at us as deities. They are now domesticated, and reliant on us for safety and protection. Our technological prowess is like magic to them, and manipulating their belief system was an easy task. We now have full access to the Murmuring Monolith.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个前智慧物种的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for this pre-sapient species appears here.

texts.zh: 我们有机会研究[beholder_planet.GetName]上的远古低语金字塔了。
texts.en: We have an opportunity to examine the ancient Murmuring Monolith on [beholder_planet.GetName].

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

texts.zh:
我们对低语金字塔的研究看来相当耗费时间，而且所获无几。它的秘密仿佛在和我们玩捉迷藏一样。毫无疑问这座四棱锥里一定有什么先进的科技，但它产出的庞大能量以我们目前的科学理解而言是非常怪异的。

在金字塔的外墙之内一定发生着什么特别的事情。新的一群[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]开始涌向金字塔。与最初的保卫领土的行为相比，它们现在似乎很平静，甚至有所期待。有什么事情要发生了。
texts.en:
Our study of the Murmuring Monolith has proven time consuming and less revealing than we anticipated. The structure's secrets elude us. There is undeniably advanced technology within the pyramid, but the sheer amount of energy being produced is inconsistent with our current understanding of science.

Beyond the walls of the Monolith, something unusual is going on. A fresh influx of [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] have begun crowding the Monolith. In contrast with their initial territorial behavior, they now seem to be calm, and even anticipatory. Something is about to happen.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个前智慧物种的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for this pre-sapient species appears here.

texts.zh: 我们试图驯化[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]，本以为将他们的信仰从金字塔转向我们是轻而易举的事情。不幸的是我们的尝试适得其反，激起他们激烈的反抗。一个巨大的群体开始包围起低语金字塔。我们仍无法接近。
texts.en: We attempted to domesticate the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj], assuming we would make short work of refocusing their worship from the Monolith to us. Unfortunately our attempts have backfired, and we have provoked an aggressive response. A great crowd has appeared to blockade the Murmuring Monolith. We cannot gain access.

label.zh: 真不幸。强行清除这片区域。
label.en: Unfortunate. Clear the area by force.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个前智慧物种的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for this pre-sapient species appears here.

texts.zh: 在粗暴的火力展示后，我们让[beholder_presapients.GetAdj]被迫意识到我们的优越性。尽管在智力上存在巨大的鸿沟，他们还是吸取教训，明白挡我们的路不符合它们的最佳利益。许多人吓得落荒而逃，回到它们的巢穴中。现在我们可以不受干扰地研究低语金字塔了。
texts.en: After a bold display of firepower, we have forced the [beholder_presapients.GetAdj] to recognize our superiority. Despite the gulf between our intellects, they have absorbed the lesson that it is not in their best interest to stand in our way. Many have fled in fear, retreating to their dwellings. The Murmuring Monolith can now be examined without interference.

label.zh: 我们就是做了一些必要的事罢了。
label.en: We did what we had to do.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这个前智慧物种的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for this pre-sapient species appears here.

summary.text:
# 峰值读数 / Spiky Readings

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration · DLC：Galactic Paragons（has_paragon_dlc）

## 如何开始 How it starts

拥有 Galactic Paragons 且所有者不是集体意识帝国时，带有 pre_sapient_planet 标志的星球可能生成（2级，权重3，全局一次 max_once_global）。生成时 on_spawn 保存该星球的前智慧物种为 beholder_presapients，并给其未开化人口添加灵能特质。

With Galactic Paragons and an owner that is not a gestalt, a planet flagged pre_sapient_planet can spawn it (level 2, weight 3, once globally via max_once_global). on_spawn saves the planet's pre-sapient species as beholder_presapients and gives its non-sapient pops a psionic trait.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

1. paragon.3“峰值读数”：选项a记录该星球为 beholder_planet，设置国家标志 beholder_chain_owner，20-40天后 paragon.4；选项b放弃。
2. paragon.4“低语金字塔”：给星球添加 the_beholder_presapients_protected 修正，四个选项取决于国家：a 友好接触（非军国主义、非排外）→ 项目 BEFRIENDING_BEHOLDER_PRESAPIENTS“建立信任”（1000社会，科学船+技能1）→ paragon.5“不言而信”（+2000社会研究）→ 20-40天后 paragon.25；b 强力研究（非灵性者 60% / 灵性者 80% 成功 → paragon.10“伪神”，否则 paragon.11“伪神”→ paragon.15“抵抗瓦解”）；c 武力压制（非和平主义且非亲外星）→ paragon.15；d 放弃（清除链）。paragon.10 / paragon.15 之后启用项目 WHISPER_TEMPLE_STUDY“研究低语的巨石”（500社会）→ paragon.20“探索低语金字塔”→ 20-40天后 paragon.25。
3. paragon.25“低语呢喃”→ paragon.26“低语呢喃”：启用项目 WHISPER_TEMPLE_ENERGY“低语的巨石：能量”（1000工程，科学船+技能2）→ paragon.30“凝望者”：a 支付1200能量 → 20-40天后 paragon.1；b 按能量收入给 the_beholder_energy_big/medium/small 修正，并分别在360/720/1440天后触发 paragon.1；c 放弃。
4. paragon.1“飞船”：可招募传奇领袖“观察者”（心灵感应的指挥官，带“低语之殿”舰船），或遣散；另有两个对话选项。

1. paragon.3 "Spiky Readings": option a records the planet as beholder_planet, sets the country flag beholder_chain_owner and fires paragon.4 20-40 days later; option b walks away.
2. paragon.4 "The Murmuring Monolith": adds the modifier the_beholder_presapients_protected to the planet; four options depending on the country: a friendly approach (non-militarist, non-xenophobe) → project BEFRIENDING_BEHOLDER_PRESAPIENTS "Building Trust" (1000 society, science ship, skill 1) → paragon.5 "Trust Within Sight" (+2000 society research) → paragon.25 20-40 days later; b forceful study (60% for non-spiritualists / 80% for spiritualists success → paragon.10 "False Gods", otherwise paragon.11 "False Gods" → paragon.15 "Resistance Discouraged"); c suppress by force (non-pacifist and non-xenophile) → paragon.15; d leave (ends the chain). After paragon.10 / paragon.15 the project WHISPER_TEMPLE_STUDY "Study the Murmuring Monolith" (500 society) is enabled → paragon.20 "Exploring the Murmuring Monolith" → paragon.25 20-40 days later.
3. paragon.25 "The Murmuring" → paragon.26 "The Murmuring": enables project WHISPER_TEMPLE_ENERGY "Murmuring Monolith: Energy" (1000 engineering, science ship, skill 2) → paragon.30 "The Beholder": a pay 1200 energy → paragon.1 20-40 days later; b take a the_beholder_energy_big/medium/small modifier depending on energy income and get paragon.1 after 360/720/1440 days; c abandon.
4. paragon.1 "A Ship": recruit the legendary leader "The Beholder" (a psionic commander with the "Temple of Whispers" ship) or dismiss him; two dialogue options.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

paragon.4 的四个选项由国家性格决定（互斥）；b 的成败是 60/40（灵性者 80/20）；之后三条路线（友好/研究/压制）汇合到 paragon.25。paragon.30 的三个选项互斥，决定 paragon.1 出现的时间。若该星球易主，隐藏事件 paragon.100–102 会移除受保护修正并终止链。

paragon.4's four options are decided by the country's traits (alternatives); b succeeds 60/40 (80/20 for spiritualists); the three routes (friendly / study / suppress) then converge on paragon.25. paragon.30's three options are alternatives and decide when paragon.1 appears. If the planet changes hands, the hidden events paragon.100-102 remove the protection modifier and end the chain.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

paragon.4 各选项按军国主义、排外、灵性、和平主义、亲外星限制；paragon.30 选项a需要1200能量，选项b按能量收入分三档。

paragon.4's options are gated by militarist, xenophobe, spiritualist, pacifist and xenophile; paragon.30's option a needs 1200 energy and option b splits into three tiers by energy income.
